purpose: Find a chart-drawable manual XAUUSD strategy for multi-hour H1 moves with M5 triggers and H1-scaled targets, rather than simply enlarging R3 TP.
scales: EMA zone offset0/.25 ATR H1; breakout channel12/24 H1, breakout state lasts6h; sweep6/12 H1 lows-highs; prior-day sweep penetration0/.1 ATR H1; FVG near edge/midpoint, minimum width.1 ATR H1, state lasts8h; compression6/12 H1 range<=4 ATR H1.
causality: All H1/H4 levels from candles completed at the M5 OPEN. Freeze level at first touch; trigger first closed M5 reclaim within30 minutes, or immediate closed M5 channel breakout for compression. Enter at next M1 OPEN only if timestamp exists. No unconfirmed pivots. First touch per direction/date/WIBsession07-14,14-19,19-24; breakout/FVG only first touch of unique source state. Touch consumed before discretionary filters.
constraints: One position, max2 fills per WIB date. Mon-Fri only; time exit max23:55 WIB so no overnight/swap assumed. Reject entry at or beyond23:55. No martingale or layering; model0.5% equity risk including costs. Long/short quote convention uses bid OHLC, synthetic ask spread.
trailing: After favorable M1 extreme reaches1 initial ATR H1, only at a later H1 boundary update stop from the prior completed H1 close minus/plus1.5 initial ATR H1. Stop monotonic; new stop eligible only after its information is available. Fixed target remains in place; same-minute SL/TP is SL-first.
costs: Base spread.30/oz, adverse slip.05/oz each side, roundtrip fee.07/oz. Gapped SL uses worse M1 opening price, TP never improved. Bid/ask costs kept for stop/target checks. Stress costs1.5x and2x, latency1m/5m, entry distance/news/session rechecked. Intrabar adverse/favorable equity ordering bound, not tick-verified true DD.
news: No new entries +/-30m CPI/PPI/NFP, +/-60m FOMC. Existing positions remain exposed to news; no claim that this entry guard removes holding risk. Archived calendar incomplete for other events. Daily macro is not used for selection because point-in-time release/vintage unavailable.
selection: Screen train2019-22 only; rank per style min150 fills, positive meanR, trainingPF>=1.10, conservative mean-1.96*SE, top3 per style deduplicated by same trade signature. Validate shortlist2019-24, one-position/day caps, cost1.5x+delay1m. Preferred candidate needs train>=150,val>=80,positive train&val,PF>=1.10 in both,val stressedPF>=1,>=4 positive years2019-24. Rank by minimum train/val conservative meanR and minimum stressed meanR; freeze up to3 ranked candidates before2025. If none pass, report failed search rather than force recommendation. Inspect neighboring geometry stability after freeze, never switch because2025 is attractive.
additional_2025: Only after freeze. 2025 has already been inspected in prior research: exploratory comparison, not fresh/blinded out-of-sample. 2019-24 also reused; multiple testing acknowledged. No broker-native ticks/2026 performance claims.
scope: Research only. Keep deployed Manual R3 and Frozen V1 unchanged until candidate evidence warrants integration. No live orders. Save code, protocol, ledgers, annual results and independent scalar audit. Report every selected candidate including failures.
